# myip

> Self-hosted Go IP information API. All request-time lookups use local MMDB
> databases; only the separate updater contacts data providers.

Repository: https://github.com/TrueFix/ip
Go module: github.com/TrueFix/myip (intentionally different from repository name).
Docker image: mayankfawkes/ip. The same image runs API, updater or benchmark commands.

## Documentation

- [README](README.md): overview and credential-free quick start.
- [Deployment](DEPLOYMENT.md): standalone DB-IP/MaxMind Compose installation.
- [Environment](docs/ENVIRONMENT.md): complete variable tables by source/purpose.
- [API reference](docs/REFERENCE.md): response contract, source selection, proxies and storage.
- [Production](deploy/PRODUCTION.md): hardening, updates, rollback and releases.

- [Security](SECURITY.md): reporting and deployment boundaries.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): development rules.
- [Data licensing](THIRD_PARTY.md): attribution and provider terms.
- [Changelog](CHANGELOG.md): release history.

## Contract

- Public routes: /, /<public-ip>, /healthz, /docs, /flags/<country>.svg,
  /country-data.json on port 8080. HEAD and CORS preflight are supported.
- Private /metrics and /databases on port 9090 have no authentication; never
  publish them unprotected. There is no HTML frontend or API-key authentication.
- Missing data remains null. Postal codes are excluded. Flag/docs URLs follow
  validated request origin; BASE_URL and DOCS_URL are obsolete.
- dbip mode: DB-IP City/ASN only; no credentials.
- maxmind mode: MaxMind primary plus DB-IP fallback; updater requires account ID
  and license key. Fallback selects whole location records, not mixed coordinates.
- IPinfo Lite is optional enrichment in maxmind mode, requiring a download token.
  Enrichment must not merge conflicting ASNs. ISP_FROM_ASN uses the downloaded
  IPinfo operator name as an ISP approximation, not a verified retail ISP.
- No VPN, proxy, Tor, cloud or residential classification is implemented.
- RATELIMIT_ENABLE=false is the only switch to bypass all built-in limiting.
  When enabled, RATE_LIMIT_RPM=0 admits zero rate-limited requests. Readiness,
  private monitoring and CORS preflight are exempt. Limits are process-local;
  IPv6 /64 addresses share a budget. They do not persist visitor IPs to SQLite.

## Architecture and operations

- internal/httpapi: HTTP, proxy/origin validation, limiter and Prometheus.
- internal/geo: MMDB readers, response enrichment and atomic reader reloads.
- internal/updater: staged downloads, writer lock and snapshot publication.
- internal/inventory and internal/audit: checksums and SQLite update history.
- DATA_DIR defaults to ./data locally and /data in Docker. API mounts it read-only;
  one updater writes it. current.json selects an immutable versioned snapshot.
- API does not need provider credentials and makes no external lookup requests.
  Never read, print or commit real .env, secrets, production data or database files.
- Trust only actual ingress CIDRs and sanitized forwarding headers. ALLOWED_HOSTS
  restricts response origins; it is not authentication. Keep metrics private.
- Docker image tags, published ports and mounts are edited directly in Compose,
  not through Docker-only environment variables. Environment forwarding differs
  between simple templates and hardened root Compose; consult the variable guide.
- Never use docker compose down -v for a normal upgrade. Preserve the data volume.
- Releases contain 20 raw API executables plus SHA-256 checksums, no archives or
  helper executables. The target list is scripts/release-targets.txt. Raw binaries
  need provisioned databases and a separate updater. Native MaxMind updates need
  geoipupdate. Cross-compilation is not native runtime verification.

## Development

Use the Go version in go.mod, Python 3 and Docker Compose v2. Run make check,
make audit and the container smoke test before tagging; see TESTING.md.
Keep source attribution and nullability intact. Use synthetic fixtures for tests.
Do not add per-request network calls, fabricated classification or visitor-IP storage.
The single workflow verifies main pushes, manual runs and tags. Both publishing
jobs require successful tests, audits and a production-image smoke test, and
publish only on version-tag pushes. Only the newest known stable tag promotes latest.
